note: Hand-derived from canonicalProvenanceDerivedFromCypher (go/internal/storage/cypher/edge/writer/derived_from.go): `UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (img:ContainerImage {digest: row.digest}) MATCH (base:ContainerImage {digest: row.base_digest}) MERGE (img)-[rel:DERIVED_FROM {scope_id: row.scope_id, evidence_source: row.evidence_source}]->(base) SET ...`. DERIVED_FROM is the only type this writer can emit (fixed template, no vocabulary substitution). The source is the resolved descriptor id (oci-descriptor://registry/repository@digest, matching the sibling built_from fixtures) of the built child digest, the target the resolved descriptor id of the Dockerfile-declared base digest. scope_id and evidence_source are MERGE identity the WRITER stamps per run, so the fixture pins the live contract the guard reproduces: scope_id is the owning repository's scope (the writing intent's scope), evidence_source the container-image-base-image domain. The live cell must drive the writing intent in this scope with this evidence source, or update these pins -- the guard test reds on a mismatch either way. Exactly two edges: the two children the owning repository built from its single declared base, both with attribution_basis repository_single_base (the Dockerfile-only inference seam). The base itself contributes nothing on purpose -- its decision carries both the base anchor and build provenance, and an image is never its own ancestor or CVE lineage traversal would cycle. The third-party digest contributes nothing -- exact_digest the repository merely deploys, never derivation evidence.
